rationale: Motor vehicle collision causing damage to the policyholder's vehicle and injury to the policyholder is unambiguously an auto claim.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan (POL-1003) was rear-ended at a red light on Route 9 at 8:15 AM yesterday by a vehicle traveling ~35 mph without braking. The vehicle is totaled with severe trunk damage, and the policyholder sustained whiplash and a sprained wrist. Other driver's insurance information is documented on the police report.

case_facts.description: rear-ended; other vehicle traveling ~35 mph without braking
case_facts.vehicle_damage: totaled; trunk crushed into back seat

rationale: A tree from the policyholder's own property fell on their parked vehicle, causing damage to the hood and windshield; this is a motor vehicle comprehensive loss covered under auto insurance.
claim_summary: Riley Kim's maple tree fell in high wind and struck her parked vehicle in the driveway, causing significant damage to the hood and windshield. This is a comprehensive auto loss covered under her home-auto bundle policy (POL-1005, $1,000 deductible, $400,000 limit). Adjuster inspection needed to confirm repair estimate.

case_facts.description: maple tree from own property fell in wind and struck parked car
case_facts.estimated_damage: hood and windshield damage—estimate pending adjuster inspection
